name: Century Seasons
address: Survey No. 39/1, Lakshmipura Village, NH 648, Doddaballapur–Devanahalli Road, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka
description: Century Seasons is a 25-acre plotted development in Devanahalli, planned around themed landscape areas and shared recreation. Century describes close to half the development as open space, with more than 40 amenities distributed across 21 green pockets. Its proposition combines the flexibility of an individually built home with a planned community landscape.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Century Seasons located?
faqs.answer: Survey No. 39/1, Lakshmipura Village, NH 648, Doddaballapur–Devanahalli Road, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka, 562110. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 30 × 50 ft plot, 40 × 60 ft plot. Documented plot areas span 1500–2400 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹1.13 Cr–₹1.8 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Ready to move. Published timeline: Ready to move, portal reference January 2025. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Clubhouse, Swimming pool, Gymnasium, Children’s play area, Jogging track, Landscaped gardens. 40+ developer-marketed amenities across 21 green pockets. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: 25 acre plotted development Close to 50 percent open space marketed by Century 40 plus amenities across 21 green pockets. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
